lines.en: label utadorm20:
: We’re hooooooome!
lines.zh: : 我们回——家——啦！

lines.en: scene utacomeshome1
: Oh, hey. It’s the only two people in Kumon-mi that I like, inconspicuously showing up at the dorm together just before midnight.
lines.zh: : 哦，嘿。是我在 Kumon-mi 里仅有的两个喜欢的人，在快到午夜的时候不声不响地一起出现在宿舍。

lines.en: : Hey, Io. I’m surprised to see you still awake.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Io。没想到你还醒着。

lines.en: scene utacomeshome2
Uta tosses her hat and scarf onto an already large pile of clothes on the floor before taking her place next to Io.
lines.zh: Uta 把帽子和围巾扔到地板上那堆已经很大的衣服上，然后坐到了 Io 旁边。

lines.en: : Sensei and I did karaoke together!
lines.zh: : Sensei 和我一起去唱卡拉 OK 了！

lines.en: : Well, I did karaoke.
lines.zh: : 嗯，是我唱了卡拉 OK。

lines.en: : Sensei just stood there all night and watched me because he’s a creep.
lines.zh: : Sensei 就整晚站在那儿看着我，因为他是个变态。

lines.en: She conveniently leaves out the part where we almost kissed.
lines.zh: 她很方便地略过了我们差点接吻那一段。

lines.en: : Did you have fun?
lines.zh: : 玩得开心吗？

lines.en: : Lots.
lines.zh: : 超开心。

lines.en: : You should have invited me. I would have definitely come if it was just you two.
lines.zh: : 你们该叫上我的。如果只是你们俩，我肯定会去的。

lines.en: : Do you sing as well, Io?
lines.zh: : 你也会唱歌吗，Io？

lines.en: scene utacomeshome3
: Nope! I’m horrible. But I could have joined you in being creepy and just staring at Uta as she dances around in circles all night.
lines.zh: : 不会！我唱得烂透了。不过我可以跟你一起变态，整晚盯着 Uta 转圈圈跳舞看。

lines.en: : What a surprise that you and I are on the same page once again.
lines.zh: : 你和我又一次想到一块儿去了，真是一点都不意外。

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. Get a room.
lines.zh: : 行啦行啦。去开个房吧。

lines.en: scene utacomeshome4
: Maybe some other time. I actually have to run over to my aunt’s really quick because I just realized I left my phone over there.
lines.zh: : 改天吧。我其实得赶紧去我姑姑那儿一趟，因为我刚想起来手机落在那儿了。

lines.en: : Can I trust you to take care of our teacher for the next thirty minutes or so without me?
lines.zh: : 接下来这三十分钟左右，我能放心把你俩的老师交给你照顾吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know, Io. He’s always lookin’ at me with this weird fire in his eyes like he’s preparing to devour me whole.
lines.zh: : 我不知道啊，Io。他总是用那种奇怪的、眼里冒火的眼神看着我，像是准备把我整个吞下去。

lines.en: : I’d feel a lot safer with your supervision.
lines.zh: : 有你看着，我会觉得安全得多。

lines.en: scene utacomeshome5
: Sensei, will you be a good boy and promise to not devour Uta while I’m at my aunt’s house?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你能不能乖一点，答应我在我去姑姑家的时候别把 Uta 吃掉？

lines.en: : No. She is doomed.
lines.zh: : 不能。她死定了。

lines.en: scene utacomeshome6
: Welp, I’ve done all I can.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我能做的都做了。

lines.en: : Thank you for trying. If you are unable to find my body when you come home, please tell my parents I love them and my brother that he is an idiot.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你的努力。如果你回来的时候找不到我的尸体，请告诉我爸妈我爱他们，再告诉我哥他是个白痴。

lines.en: : Will do.
lines.zh: : 会的。

lines.en: scene utacomeshome7
: Um...if you’re gone by the time I get back...is it okay if I text you to say goodnight and stuff?
lines.zh: : 嗯……如果我回来的时候你已经走了……我可以发短信跟你说晚安什么的吗？

lines.en: : Sure. It’s already extremely late, so I imagine I'll be gone by then anyway.
lines.zh: : 当然。已经很晚了，所以我想那时候我大概也已经走了。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure Uta only invited me here to seduce me. And I doubt that will take long since I’m always staring at her with fire in my eyes or whatever it was she said.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定 Uta 叫我到这儿来就是为了勾引我。而且我怀疑这用不了多久，毕竟我总是用“眼里冒火”之类的眼神盯着她——管她刚才怎么说的。

lines.en: : Okay! Yeah! I’ll...get going then!
lines.zh: : 好！那！我……这就走了！

lines.en: : See ya!
lines.zh: : 回头见！

lines.en: scene utacomeshome8
Io quickly puts her shoes on and darts out of the room, immediately thrusting Uta and I into yet another situation where we’re alone...
lines.zh: Io 迅速穿上鞋冲出房间，立刻把 Uta 和我推进了又一个独处的局面……

lines.en: Which, I’m pretty sure, is what she was inviting me here to get away from.
lines.zh: 而我敢肯定，她叫我到这儿来，正是为了躲开这种局面。

lines.en: : She didn’t even react to you saying I was gonna seduce you...
lines.zh: : 我说我要勾引你，她居然一点反应都没有……

lines.en: : She either trusts you wholeheartedly or is completely open to the idea of you and I hooking up on your side of the room.
lines.zh: : 她要么是完全信任你，要么就是对我们俩在你那半边房间搞到一起这件事完全开放。

lines.en: scene utacomeshome9
: Sorry, Sensei. You know the rule about my parents, and there’s no way I’d be able to call them this late without waking them up and getting them all grumpy.
lines.zh: : 抱歉啊，Sensei。你知道我爸妈那条规矩的，而且这么晚我根本不可能给他们打电话还不把他们吵醒、惹得他们一肚子火。

lines.en: : Then it appears we will have to continue awkwardly flirting with one another and pretending we never-
lines.zh: : 那看来我们只能继续尴尬地互相调情，然后假装我们从来没——

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. A thing happened and now you think you’re a step closer to gettin’ your hands on the goods.
lines.zh: : 行啦行啦。反正发生了点事，现在你觉得离得手又近了一步。

lines.en: scene utacomeshome10
: Only problem is that the goods are out of stock and you’ve gotta wait for the store to replenish ‘em.
lines.zh: : 唯一的问题是，货已经没库存了，你得等店里补货。

lines.en: : Would you mind telling me when the next shipment is so I can mark my calendar?
lines.zh: : 介意告诉我下一批货什么时候到吗？我好记在日历上。

lines.en: : Sorry, no. We closed for good and aren’t accepting deliveries anymore.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，不行。我们永久停业了，不再接受任何配送。

lines.en: : I’m beginning to think your objective tonight was to just make me want you even more than I already do.
lines.zh: : 我开始觉得，你今晚的目标就是让我比原来更想要你。

lines.en: scene utacomeshome11
: I don’t really have objectives. I kinda just do what I do and hope nothing explodes as a result.
lines.zh: : 我其实没什么目标。我就是做我该做的，然后祈祷别有什么东西因此炸掉。

lines.en: : I don’t have a problem with you wanting me and stuff, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你想要我什么的，我没意见。

lines.en: : So if tonight somehow made you want me more for...{i}reasons{/i}...that’s totally okay.
lines.zh: : 所以如果今晚因为……{i}某些原因{/i}……让你更想要我了，那完全没问题。

lines.en: scene utacomeshome12
: Not that I think you’d be able to help yourself to begin with. I can basically buy a house with all of the money you’ve given me.
lines.zh: : 反正我觉得你一开始也管不住自己。你给我的钱都够我买栋房子了。

lines.en: : Stop taking advantage of my heart. It’s not fair.
lines.zh: : 别再占我心的便宜了。这不公平。

lines.en: scene utacomeshome13
: {size=-15}...What do you know about “fair?”{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-15}……“公平”这个词，你懂什么？{/size}

lines.en: : Hm? What was that?
lines.zh: : 嗯？你说什么？

lines.en: scene utacomeshome14
: I said...what do you know about chairs!
lines.zh: : 我说……你对椅子懂什么！

lines.en: : ...Chairs?
: Yeah! Cause...we should sit...and...since there’s no good place...how about the kotatsu?!
lines.zh: : 对啊！因为……我们该坐下来……而且……既然没什么好地方……不如去暖桌那边？！

lines.en: : Do you actually think that was a good cover?
lines.zh: : 你觉得这个掩饰很高明？

lines.en: scene utacomeshome15
: Don’t know! But I’m not about to wait around and find out! My feet are killin’ me.
lines.zh: : 不知道！但我可不想留下来慢慢验证！我脚快疼死了。

lines.en: : So either sit down or get the heck out, mister.
lines.zh: : 所以要么坐下，要么滚蛋，先生。

lines.en: : Can we not sit on the bed instead?
lines.zh: : 我们不能改坐床上吗？

lines.en: : After what happened earlier? Heck no we can’t. I ain’t trying to lose my virginity in the thirty minute window of Io going to get her phone.
lines.zh: : 在发生了刚才那事之后？想都别想。我可不想在 Io 去拿手机的三十分钟窗口里把处女之身弄丢。

lines.en: : What if she calls one of us right before it goes in and I get surprised and jump and then it splits me in half and there’s blood everywhere?
lines.zh: : 万一她就在那东西进去之前给我们谁打了个电话，我吓一跳猛地一跳，然后它把我劈成两半，到处都是血呢？

lines.en: : Does that sound fun to you?
lines.zh: : 你觉得那样很好玩？

lines.en: : I mean...up until the “blood everywhere” part...
lines.zh: : 我是说……在“到处都是血”之前的部分……

lines.en: scene utacomeshome16
: Just sit down, you friggin’ horndog...
lines.zh: : 坐下吧，你这个该死的色鬼……

lines.en: scene black
I take my shoes off and sit in the same spot where Io passed out on my lap the other day.
lines.zh: 我脱了鞋，坐在那天 Io 昏倒在我腿上的同一个位置。

lines.en: Uta does the same after grabbing a carton of strawberry milk out of Io’s mini fridge and, within a matter of seconds, things start going back to normal.
lines.zh: Uta 从 Io 的小冰箱里拿了盒草莓牛奶，也坐了下来，几秒钟之内，一切又恢复了正常。

lines.en: scene utacomeshome17
I guess “normal” is a pretty subjective term when it comes to my relationship with Uta, though, as I’m learning now that it hasn’t even really begun yet.
lines.zh: 不过我想，放到我和 Uta 的关系上，“正常”是个相当主观的词——我现在才明白，它甚至还没真正开始。

lines.en: There’s clearly a lot that I don’t yet understand about her, and I feel like it wouldn’t be too much of a stretch to imagine that there’s a lot she doesn’t understand about herself yet either.
lines.zh: 显然我还有很多不了解她的地方，而且我觉得，她自己也有很多不了解自己的地方，这也不算太离谱。

lines.en: Granted, I could be completely wrong considering when I confronted her about her selflessness, she immediately refuted it.
lines.zh: 当然，我也可能完全错了——毕竟我指出她太为别人着想的时候，她立刻就否认了。

lines.en: Either way, the uncomfortable air blends in with the typical wood stain scented air of her dorm room and things, once again, move into an area of conversation we’re both more comfortable with.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，那股不自在的空气混进了她宿舍里常有的木器漆味，一切又转回了一个我们俩都更自在的谈话区域。

lines.en: : Io’s great, isn’t she?
lines.zh: : Io 很棒，对吧？

lines.en: That area being talking about others instead of talking about ourselves.
lines.zh: 那个区域就是：聊别人，而不是聊我们自己。

lines.en: : She said the same thing about you the other day.
lines.zh: : 她那天也这么说过你。

lines.en: scene utacomeshome18
: Oooooh...what else did she say? Anything juicy?
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦……她还说了什么？有什么劲爆的吗？

lines.en: : I’ve always been curious about what she says about me while I’m not around.
lines.zh: : 我一直很好奇我不在的时候她都怎么说我。

lines.en: : Only issue is that she never talks to anybody, so this is the first chance I’ve had to find out.
lines.zh: : 唯一的问题是她从来不跟任何人说话，所以这是我第一次有机会打听出来。

lines.en: : She said a few things. But the one that stuck out most to me is that you “got better.”
lines.zh: : 她说了几句。但让我印象最深的是她说你“好起来了”。

lines.en: : Whatever that means.
lines.zh: : 天知道那是什么意思。

lines.en: scene utacomeshome19
: Should we deflect this conversation topic as well?
lines.zh: : 这个话题我们也要岔开吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. My brain’s already overloaded from almost locking lips with you earlier and I’d rather not get into what that means right now.
lines.zh: : 对。我的脑子刚才因为差点跟你嘴对嘴已经超载了，我现在不想去想那是什么意思。

lines.en: scene utacomeshome20
: We can keep talking about Io, though! Just nothing bad, because she’s my BFF and I don’t wanna say mean stuff about her behind her back.
lines.zh: : 不过我们可以继续聊 Io！就是别说坏话，因为她是我最好的朋友，我不想在背后说她坏话。

lines.en: : Fine. But I’m going to let you lead the conversation since you’re the one who’s done nothing but show opposition to pretty much everything since we stepped into the karaoke booth.
lines.zh: : 行。不过我让你来主导话题，因为从我们踏进卡拉 OK 包厢开始，你基本上对什么都持反对态度。

lines.en: scene utacomeshome21
: Done deal! Trust in Uta and you shall receive the best darn conversation you’ve had all night!
lines.zh: : 成交！相信 Uta，你将收获今晚最他妈棒的一场对话！

lines.en: : The competition is very weak, all things considered.
lines.zh: : 综合考虑下来，竞争对手非常弱。

lines.en: : Shush.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴。
: 那么……

lines.en: : She hasn’t told me about it, but...based on the way she acted around you tonight, I bet that...
lines.zh: : 她没跟我说过，不过……看她今晚围着你的样子，我敢打赌……

lines.en: : She told you she likes you.
lines.zh: : 她告诉你她喜欢你。

lines.en: : Perceptive.
lines.zh: : 挺敏锐的嘛。

lines.en: scene utacomeshome22
: Did she give you the robot or did she chicken out? I think that one could have gone either way.
lines.zh: : 她是给了你那个机器人，还是临阵脱逃了？我觉得那件事两种可能都有。

lines.en: : The robot is now living on a table in my bedroom.
lines.zh: : 那个机器人现在住在我卧室的桌子上。

lines.en: : Awwwwww, that’s so cute.
lines.zh: : 哇啊啊啊，好可爱。

lines.en: : She likes you a lot, you know. Which means you’re the first crush she’s ever had.
lines.zh: : 她很喜欢你，你知道吗。也就是说，你是她这辈子第一个喜欢上的人。

lines.en: : Which means she’ll take it a bajillion times harder if you do anything to make her sad.
lines.zh: : 也就是说，如果你做了任何让她伤心的事，她会难受上一万亿倍。

lines.en: : Like kissing her best friend?
lines.zh: : 比如亲了她最好的朋友？

lines.en: scene utacomeshome23
: Guh. Well, at least we lasted a solid two minutes without bringin’ it up. But yes, like kissing her best friend.
lines.zh: : 呃。好吧，至少我们撑了整整两分钟才提起这件事。不过对，比如亲了她最好的朋友。

lines.en: : To move away from Io territory for a second...what about you, Uta?
lines.zh: : 那我们暂时离开 Io 的地盘一会儿……你呢，Uta？

lines.en: scene utacomeshome24
: Hm? What {i}about{/i} me?
lines.zh: : 嗯？我{i}什么{/i}？

lines.en: : Who was your first crush?
lines.zh: : 你第一个喜欢上的人是谁？

lines.en: scene utacomeshome25
: Hmm...good question. Who {i}was{/i} my first crush?...
lines.zh: : 嗯……好问题。我第一个喜欢上的人{i}是谁{/i}来着？……

lines.en: : Maybe Spongebob?
lines.zh: : 也许是海绵宝宝？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 干嘛？

lines.en: scene utacomeshome24
: You know. The cartoon sponge. Hangs out with a starfish.
lines.zh: : 你知道的。那个卡通海绵。跟一只海星混在一起的那个。

lines.en: : Your first crush was on a cartoon sponge?
lines.zh: : 你第一个喜欢的人是卡通海绵？

lines.en: : Sure. He was cute.
lines.zh: : 对啊。他很可爱嘛。

lines.en: : I never wanted to do him or anything cause I was just a little girl, but I used to talk about marryin’ him and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我当时只是个小女孩，从来没想过要跟他做什么，不过我以前老说要嫁给他什么的。

lines.en: : You have come a very long way, Uta.
lines.zh: : 你可真是走了好长一段路啊，Uta。

lines.en: scene utacomeshome26
: I’ve had all kinds of crushes before.
lines.zh: : 我以前喜欢过各种各样的。

lines.en: : Cartoons. Boys. Girls.
lines.zh: : 卡通人物。男生。女生。

lines.en: : I even had a crush on Io for a little while.
lines.zh: : 我甚至有段时间喜欢过 Io。

lines.en: : Excuse me?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : Yup. You heard that right.
lines.zh: : 对。你没听错。

lines.en: : Does...she know that?
lines.zh: : 那……她知道吗？

lines.en: scene utacomeshome27
: No. And she’s never gonna find out because, if you tell her, you’ll never see another flavor beam for the rest of your life.
lines.zh: : 不知道。而且她永远都不会知道——因为如果你告诉她，你这辈子都别想再见到一根味道棒了。

lines.en: : Do you still feel that way?
lines.zh: : 你现在还是那种感觉吗？

lines.en: : Sensei, I mean it. Don’t even think about it.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我是认真的。想都别想。

lines.en: : I’m not going to tell her. I’m just genuinely curious.
lines.zh: : 我不会告诉她的。我只是真的好奇。

lines.en: scene utacomeshome28
: No. I don’t feel that way anymore.
lines.zh: : 不。我现在没那种感觉了。

lines.en: : It was only for a little while anyway. Like, barely even a couple weeks.
lines.zh: : 反正也就那么一小段时间。大概连两个星期都不到。

lines.en: : I’ve just always had a hard time wrangling up my feelings and, before I know it, I wind up getting attached to stuff I don’t even have.
lines.zh: : 我一直很难管住自己的感情，等我反应过来，我已经对那些我根本没拥有的东西产生了依恋。

lines.en: : It’s kinda pathetic, actually. And it’s made me do some really stupid stuff in the past.
lines.zh: : 其实挺可悲的。而且它让我在过去做过一些真的很蠢的事。

lines.en: scene utacomeshome29
: Buuuuuut that’s gettin’ a little too close to the “Uta doesn’t wanna talk about it right now” zone and I think it might be time for another topic change.
lines.zh: : 不不不不过这也太接近“Uta 现在不想谈这个”的区域了，我觉得该换个话题了。

lines.en: : What kind of stupid stuff?
lines.zh: : 什么样的蠢事？

lines.en: scene utacomeshome24
: Sensei, I know you may be in love with me, but you really need to start payin’ attention to what I say and not just my boobs.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我知道你可能爱我爱得不行，但你真的该开始注意我说的话，而不只是我的胸。

lines.en: : I heard what you said, I’m just choosing to ignore it because I’m curious.
lines.zh: : 我听见你说什么了，我只是选择无视，因为我好奇。

lines.en: : Well that’s just plain rude and you’re a big ole jerk for doing that.
lines.zh: : 那简直太没礼貌了，你这么做就是个大混蛋。

lines.en: : Will you tell me eventually?
lines.zh: : 你最终会告诉我的吧？

lines.en: scene utacomeshome28
: Yes. Whether I want to or not.
lines.zh: : 会。不管我想不想。

lines.en: : It’ll slip out because, contrary to what Io may have said about me, I’m not “better.”
lines.zh: 它总会溜出来的，因为和 Io 可能对你的评价相反，我并没有“好起来”。

lines.en: : I just don’t say the same kinda stuff she says about herself because my brain is stupid and makes me think that anything that’s said out loud is real.
lines.zh: : 我只是不像她说自己那样，把同样的话挂在嘴边，因为我的脑子很蠢，它让我觉得任何说出口的东西都会变成真的。

lines.en: : So all of those smiles of yours are fake?
lines.zh: : 所以你那些笑容都是假的？

lines.en: scene utacomeshome30
: Course not. Just cause you’ve gone through some stuff in the past and can’t really get over it doesn’t mean that everything for the rest of forever is gonna be sad.
lines.zh: : 当然不是。你过去经历过一些事、又没能真正走出来，不代表从此以后的一切都会是悲伤的。

lines.en: : I’m super happy now. And I’ve got a bajillion good things going for me.
lines.zh: : 我现在超级幸福。而且我身上有成万亿件好事。

lines.en: : There’s just also some stuff I’ve gotta bury if I’m ever gonna move on.
lines.zh: : 只是也有那么一些事，我得把它们埋起来，才能继续往前走。

lines.en: : So maybe that does make me “better” if that’s the word Io is gonna use. But it’s not the one I would pick.
lines.zh: : 所以如果 Io 要用“好起来了”这个词，也许我确实算。但这不是我会选的词。

lines.en: : Now, can we stop talkin’ about depressing stuff and go back to flirting? Even the whole near kiss thing was better than this.
lines.zh: : 现在，我们能不能别聊这些丧气话，回去调情？就连那个差点亲上的事都比这强。

lines.en: : Also, you made me admit I had a crush on a sponge and now I’m mad at you.
lines.zh: : 还有，你害我承认了自己喜欢过一块海绵，现在我生你的气了。

lines.en: : Can I tell Io about the sponge crush or is that off limits too?
lines.zh: : 我能把海绵那件事告诉 Io 吗，还是说这也是禁区？

lines.en: : Io knows about the sponge crush.
lines.zh: : Io 知道海绵那件事。

lines.en: : And she still talks to you?
lines.zh: : 而她还愿意跟你说话？

lines.en: scene utacomeshome31
: Are you gonna stop talking to me because I had a crush on a sponge?!
lines.zh: : 你该不会因为我爱过一块海绵就不理我了吧？！

lines.en: : I can probably be convinced to keep associating with you.
lines.zh: : 大概可以说服我继续跟你来往。

lines.en: : Ah! I knew you’d break out the blackmail sooner or later! It was only a matter of time!
lines.zh: : 啊！我就知道你迟早会掏出勒索这一招！只是时间问题！

lines.en: : What do you want?! My first kiss? My first handie? My first child?
lines.zh: : 你想要什么？！我的初吻？我的第一次手活？我的第一个孩子？

lines.en: : Tell me, Sensei! What must you take from me?!
lines.zh: : 说吧，Sensei！你到底要夺走我什么？！

lines.en: : Your phone number will suffice.
lines.zh: : 你的电话号码就够了。

lines.en: scene utacomeshome24
: Oh.
: That’s it?
lines.zh: : 就这？

lines.en: : I’d also accept any of the three things you listed prior to my suggestion.
lines.zh: : 你前面列的三样，我也都可以接受。

lines.en: : No way. Not now that I know how easy it is to win you over.
lines.zh: : 想得美。现在我知道赢你有多容易了。

lines.en: : I forgot to add that I’ll also accept any sexy pictures you’d be willing to send me as a package deal with your phone number.
lines.zh: : 我忘了补充一句：如果你愿意，发点性感照片配上你的电话号码当套餐，我也接受。

lines.en: scene utacomeshome32
: That’s...not really something I can do...
lines.zh: : 那……我真的做不到……

lines.en: : That’s fine. I wasn’t trying to push-
lines.zh: : 没关系。我不是想逼——

lines.en: : No, like, I literally {i}can’t{/i} do that. There are parental locks on my phone and I can’t send picture messages.
lines.zh: : 不，我是说，我真的{i}做不了{/i}。我手机上有家长锁，我发不了彩信。

lines.en: I’m going to have to add somebody else onto my phone plan, aren’t I?
lines.zh: 看来我得把某个人加到我的手机套餐里了，是吧？

lines.en: : Just the number is fine, Uta.
lines.zh: : 只要号码就好，Uta。

lines.en: scene utacomeshome33
: Done! Hand it over, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 搞定！拿来吧，Sensei。

lines.en: : And get ready to be tossed into a group chat with me and Io so we all know what each other are doing every second of every day!
lines.zh: : 准备好被拉进一个我和 Io 的群聊吧，这样我们每时每刻都知道彼此在干什么！

lines.en: : I can guarantee that you do not want to know what I am doing for many seconds of many of those days.
lines.zh: : 我敢保证，那些日子里有太多秒数你在做的事是你不想知道的。

lines.en: : How come you’ve always gotta ruin everything?
lines.zh: : 你怎么总是非得把一切都毁掉？

lines.en: scene black
Uta gives me her phone number, which means I have now conquered the seventh dorm room.
lines.zh: Uta 把她的电话号码给了我，这意味着我已经征服了第七间宿舍。

lines.en: And even though she is literally incapable of sending me picture messages, I’m glad to see that we’re at least {i}progressing{/i} in some way.
lines.zh: 而即便她确实没法给我发彩信，我很高兴看到我们至少在某种程度上{i}前进{/i}了。

lines.en: Or regressing, if her attitude toward what happened in the karaoke booth doesn’t change any time soon.
lines.zh: 或者说在倒退——如果她对卡拉 OK 包厢里发生的事的态度短期内还不改变的话。

lines.en: I’m not worried about that now, though.
lines.zh: : 不过现在我不担心这个。

lines.en: I’ve learned a lot more about her today than any day before.
lines.zh: : 今天我对她的了解，比以往任何一天都多。

lines.en: And even if there are parts of her that I won’t understand for months or years to come-
lines.zh: : 而且即便她身上有些地方我几个月甚至几年后才会明白——

lines.en: I’m sure those months will be exciting.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定，那些月份会很精彩。
